confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from crowd-sourced cost-of-living aggregators (Numbeo-style and MyLifeElsewhere snippets, with Varanasi, Jodhpur and Amritsar figures) and are rough guides. Cocktail and wine anchors are weaker: direct Varanasi data was thin, so they rest on the beer and Indian bottle-price relationship and on alcohol restrictions in Uttar Pradesh. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context, not live listings. The FX observation is not confirmed as the latest: the RBA exchange-rates overview snippet showed 0.7088 as at 20 March 2026, and a third-party aggregator listed 0.7021 for 27 October 2026, which I could not verify against rba.gov.au. Treat the FX value as provisional.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors are based on Varanasi-specific aggregator snippets, cross-checked against Indian comparison cities (Jodhpur and Amritsar), with Varanasi placed below the Indian average for restaurant costs. Accommodation anchors are based on general knowledge of Indian pilgrimage and tourist-city guesthouse and hotel pricing, with no comparable-city lookup.
